job.value: learn that delivery helps listings sell and turn it on

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My account' with the 'Listings with delivery sell faster!' card makes the screen and the nudge clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Enable delivery now' is the only coloured action, inside the card at the top.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Enable delivery now', 'Selling'/'Buying' and the 'To start'/'In progress' tiles say what they open.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'SF Express' and 'service point' are familiar to HK sellers; 'Revenue vs spend' has an info icon.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Turning on delivery is a choice the seller can make now.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Insights and sales sit below; the nudge is dismissable with an X.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is the seller's own account view.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The nudge body is four lines ('Buyer pays delivery from HK$14. Drop off at any SF Express store...') to read before 'Enable delivery now'.
